js:(() => { const el = document.querySelector('.ec-modal textarea'); Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype, 'value').set.call(el, 'QA재고2-CHAIN'); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); return el.value })()

shots.name: 내역입력 구매 3 → 수정 2
steps: js:(() => { window.__pick = async (label, code) => { const W = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const d0 = [...document.querySelectorAll('[role=dialog]')].pop(); const i = [...d0.querySelectorAll('input')].find((x) => x.placeholder === label || x.getAttribute('aria-label') === label); let p = i.parentElement; while (p && !p.querySelector('button')) p = p.parentElement; p.querySelector('button').click(); await W(900); const d = [...document.querySelectorAll('[role=dialog]')].pop(); const tr = [...d.querySelectorAll('tr')].find((t) => [...t.cells].some((c) => c.innerText.trim() === code)); for (const t of ['mousedown', 'mouseup']) tr.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent(t, { bubbles: true })); tr.click(); await W(600); return label + ' ' + code }; return 'ok' })()

shots.name: 로트 삭제 막힘 → 내역 삭제 → 로트 삭제
steps: js:(async () => { const W = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); [...document.querySelectorAll('tbody tr')].find((r) => r.innerText.includes('QA재고2-CHAIN')).querySelector('a').click(); await W(600); const m = [...document.querySelectorAll('.ec-modal')].pop(); [...m.querySelectorAll('button')].find((b) => b.textContent.startsWith('사용중단/재사용')).click(); await W(300); [...m.querySelectorAll('.ec-menu button')].find((b) => b.textContent === '삭제').click(); await W(400); [...document.querySelector('[role=alertdialog]').querySelectorAll('button')].find((b) => b.textContent === '확인').click(); await W(1800); return 'ok' })()
